items.prompt: A function returns a pointer to its ordinary local Position. What must the caller assume?

options.text: The raw pointer extends the local lifetime automatically
options.why: Raw observation does not extend that local lifetime.

options.text: The Position becomes a permanent global object
options.why: A return does not change its storage duration.

options.text: It is valid whenever the old bytes look unchanged
options.why: Storage contents are not a lifetime guarantee.

options.text: The local is gone; do not access it through that pointer
options.why: Choose a value or suitable owning result instead.

items.explanation: Scope exit destroys the local object; later access through that returned observer is not made valid by a plausible address.
